_doc: Host profile for B5 — MacBook Pro, Apple M5 Max, 128 GB unified memory. Selected by hostname 'B5' or HOST_ID=b5. Nothing here is exposed off-box: there is no tunnel, so publicUrl equals localUrl throughout.
name: B5

memory._doc: ONE pool shared by CPU and GPU. There is no VRAM/RAM distinction to budget across: a model's weights are simply resident memory. The console shows a single Memory bar here and hides the separate System RAM section, and the fit check treats a model's full footprint as one number.

services.name: Service Manager
services.note: Same supervisor as on BeTenshi (scripts/manager.cjs), started by hand or by launchd; not a scheduled task.

services.name: Ollama
services.note: Every text and vision model on this box is served here, on Ollama's OpenAI-compatible /v1 surface. `llm.model` is the default the LLM tab talks to; the other pulled checkpoints (gemma4:31b-mlx, qwen3.8:27b-mlx for vision) are one `model` field away. Usually owned by Ollama.app (menu bar), in which case the manager adopts the process rather than spawning its own. Cloud is disabled in ~/.ollama/server.json and it listens on loopback only. Vision is served by qwen3-vl:32b-instruct rather than the 27B: both can see, but the VL instruct build is the one scripts/doctor.mjs has actually verified on this machine, and `serves` must name what is driven.

services.name: Local AI Toolkit
services.note: Loopback adapter over the verified /Users/alibadereddin/LocalAI toolkit. Draw Things supplies FLUX.2 image generation/editing and Wan video; MLX-Audio supplies Qwen3 ASR and preset-voice TTS. The adapter serializes heavy work and never downloads models or exposes a public listener. The historical service id `qwen` is retained because Image Studio routes that id through its established generation, gallery, queue, and edit paths.

workstreams._doc: One service, so one workstream. Ollama also serves vision (qwen3-vl, gemma4) but the console has no vision surface pointed at it yet, so offering an Image or Vision card here would advertise work this host cannot actually do.

image.label: Image Studio
image.description: Create locally with the installed FLUX image app

audio.label: Speech
audio.description: Transcribe audio and synthesize preset voices locally

runtimes._doc: WHAT ACTUALLY DRIVES EACH CAPABILITY, AND WHETHER IT HAS BEEN PROVEN. `driver` names an engine the code knows how to call (see RuntimeDriver in src/lib/runtimes.ts); `serviceId` is the service that must be up; `verifiedAt` is written ONLY by scripts/doctor.mjs, and only after it ran a real job and inspected the OUTPUT. Nothing else may set it, and no UI may infer 'ready' from a health check. This block exists because for four days in September 2026 every image this machine produced was pure static while every health check said it was fine.

vision.label: Qwen3-VL 32B Instruct
vision.note: The INSTRUCT variant deliberately. `qwen3-vl:32b` is the thinking build: Ollama's think:false does not disable its reasoning, so it spends the whole budget in `thinking` and returns an empty `content`. The doctor's vision check fails on an empty string for exactly that reason.

embedding.label: Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B
embedding.verifiedNote: 1024 dimensions in 151 ms, related 0.81 vs unrelated 0.24

image.label: FLUX.2 Klein 4B (MLX)
image.note: mflux, NOT the Draw Things CLI. On 2026-09-21 that CLI returned pure static on this machine: macOS 27's Metal compiler rejects the Metal 4 cooperative-tensor shaders it ships (matmul2d_descriptor, execution_simdgroups). The pinned July build fails SILENTLY with a valid PNG of noise; the current 26.0910.1 crashes with the shader error. The same weights render fine in the Draw Things GUI app, so this is the standalone binary. mflux runs on MLX, which is a different compute stack and already proven on this box by the speech models. Verified 512x512 in 5.3 s of sampling, 10.5 GB peak.

video.label: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
video.note: Same broken CLI as the image note above, so this is expected to fail until either the CLI works again on this macOS or an MLX video driver is added. Left DECLARED and unverified rather than deleted: the machine has the weights and the wiring, and hiding that would misreport what is here. The Video tab refuses to submit while this is unverified.
